attributes.text: A key is a long code from your account's website that lets Asha use it. Your Claude Pro or ChatGPT Plus plan does not include one; the key is billed separately by the service, per message.
The key stays only on this phone and goes only to Claude. Asha's server never sees it.

How a reminder goes: on time, again after 10 minutes, a gentle check after 20, then family on Asha (if shared). A missed dose is never added to the next one: the next morning Asha only says to take today's doses on time.
